# Esther

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v3 ch.Philippa P7](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0007)</sub>
- **Role:** teacher  <sub>[v3 ch.Wedding P19](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0019)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Mrs. Esther Bell is described as being the very picture of health.

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P43](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0043)_

## Personality

Esther is a well-meaning woman who is noticeably prone to adopting various fads. Despite appearing to be in complete health, she is also a hypochondriac who routinely dwells on her supposed aches, pains, and impending mortality.

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P43](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0043), [v3 ch.Philippa P7](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0007)_

## Traits

- hypochondriacal  <sub>[v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P43](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0043)</sub>
- given to fads  <sub>[v3 ch.Philippa P7](../source/v03-c31.md#nw-v03-c31-p0007)</sub>

## History

Esther was an overly neat woman encountered by [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Diana](../character/diana.md) while they were canvassing neighbors for the [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society). She was later mentioned by [Anne](../character/anne.md) in a letter to [Philippa Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) detailing her life as a schoolteacher at [Valley Road](../codex/places.md#valley-road).

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P38](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0038), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P39](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0039), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P42](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0042), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P46](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0046), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P47](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0047), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P48](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0048), +26 more_
